answer: Desk clerks booked unpaid ridge shifts with copied flight logs. A watch is credited only after the claimant perches a 1.4-kg falcon radio on cairn 9 of the published mesa, couples it to a 48-meter reef hydrophone string, and streams an 18-second chirp comb from a 260 m baseline, locking 23 POA for 6 epochs. Three duty listeners rebuild the comb in 1.2 s and accept only if all three match a 9 ms lag and a 0.5-degree azimuth. A reused radio serial, or two combs sharing 16 of 18 tones, drops 14 POA and shelves that key for 5 epochs. 41 cloned keys would freeze 943 POA with nobody on the ridge.
